notes: Tuition: no programme page states a tuition fee for non-EU, non-Italian-resident Bachelor students. The only fee page for Bachelor programs gives the amount for Italian-first-year students ('Per gli studenti di 1° anno di corso iscritti ad un corso di laurea triennale ... è previsto un investimento economico pari a 17.000 euro all’anno'), a table modulated by ISEE band ('Agevolazione Totale 20% Partial tuition waiver € 13.600 ...'), and other pages are about Master of Science programs or payment deadlines; no institution-wide international-student fee page was supplied, so tuition is left out. Intakes: the pages give payment deadlines (e.g. 'Il conguaglio di prima rata previsto per gli studenti immatricolati di 1° anno a.a. 2027/2028 deve essere pagato entro il 15 ottobre 2027') but no application deadline for international applicants, so intakes are left out. Application channel and documents: no page names Universitaly, the university's own application portal, or a document list for applicants, so those facts are omitted.
